name: Synthetic caller (Gemini Live, text-bridged)
description: Drives a multi-turn conversation against the pipeline using the Gemini Live Bidi API as the synthetic user. Requires the `synthetic-caller` cargo feature and the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable. Cost guardrails: 3 turn cap + 30s wall-clock cap per repetition. Default `bridge=text` forwards the caller's transcript to the pipeline as text input (bypassing pipeline STT); flip `bridge` to `audio` to exercise the full VAD/STT/LLM/TTS chain end-to-end and have the worker's per-session audit capture both caller and pipeline audio into `<captures_dir>/<session_id>/` (served by the admin UI as /audio/in and /audio/out).

scenarios.name: polite caller asks the time (text bridge)
impatient caller demands a refund (audio bridge)
